anchor_rule: One getSlot(finalized) before signature listing; inclusive window [anchor-10000, anchor]. No window changes after collection starts.
classification_rule: One row per successful RPC fetch, including on-chain failure; preserve original message/meta. Recognize the four U2 action discriminators diagnostically, including malformed shapes. Audit unchanged normalize, Kamino accept, and replay_eligibility(state=None). Success-only observed action aggregates and all-status recognized instruction counts are distinct. No account acquisition or execution.

fetch_rule.retry_on: transport failure, invalid JSON, JSON-RPC error, or null result; persist every received response

finalization_rule: No unresolved selected fetches or missing classifications; checkpoint complete=false is never a final artifact.
ordering_rule: source_index defines original RPC order; input enumeration and filesystem order are irrelevant. Canonical outputs sorted by source_index and instruction index.
selection_rule: Preserve all entries from one getSignaturesForAddress(limit=1000, commitment=finalized) in RPC order with source_index. Select first 200 entries whose slot is in the window, including failed on-chain transactions. Require 200 eligible entries; never replace a failed fetch.
